title: Writing / Voice / Embracing
slide_intent: Make language welcoming and actionable so mistakes do not feel like personal rejection.
strategic_value: Supportive feedback, neutral pronouns and clear CTAs can help Duolingo sustain learners’ willingness to continue.
demonstration: Four comparisons cover supportive correction, gender-neutral pronouns, contractions and a clear notification action.
practical_value: Check that feedback supports the person and that a button names an understandable action.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Embracing heading, micro-success rationale and opposing trait lists at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack four labeled copy comparisons at right; preserve the note that a playful phrase may work as a header but not a CTA.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source connects clear steps and encouragement with micro-successes and avoiding alienation.
reference_purposes.Expression: Supportive correction and conversational phrasing demonstrate the voice.
reference_purposes.Application: The examples show neutral pronouns, contractions and context-specific CTA wording.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source rejects aggression and gendered assumptions; it explicitly distinguishes header wording from CTA wording.

ingredient.name: Embracing voice
ingredient.role: Support progress while making the next action clear.
ingredient.application: Use supportive correction, they/them where appropriate and natural contractions; keep CTA wording explicit.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior.
